messages:
Aisha Khan: Hey folks — ran into a weird one. My spouse's claims are getting denied by UnitedCare, says 'subscriber not in network'. On the portal I only see my name, not my dependent. Anyone else seen this?
Jordan Lee: Which Redwood plan is this under — the Redwood Team PPO or the HMO?
Aisha Khan: PPO (Redwood Team Plan). Claim ID is UC-489203. Denial text from provider: 'subscriber not in network / invalid member id'.
Kelsey (People Ops): Hi Aisha — sorry about that. Sounds like a dependent enrollment sync issue with the carrier. Can you DM me your spouse's full name + DOB and a screenshot of the denial? I'll open a case with UnitedCare. Meanwhile you can call the carrier provider line at `1-800-555-1212` and reference Group #RWD-10023 — they can sometimes re-run the sync on the spot.
Aisha Khan: DM sent + attached screenshot of the denial email from the provider. Also the provider is asking for an ID card for an appointment tomorrow.
benefits-bot: Carrier case opened: UnitedCare ticket #UC-2024-1187 created by Kelsey. Status: awaiting carrier response.
Jordan Lee: If you need a card ASAP, you can print a temporary ID from the carrier portal — usually under Account > Documents > Print Member ID. If the portal is missing dependents we escalate. Mailing replacement cards usually takes 5-7 business days.
Kelsey (People Ops): Thanks — I escalated to carrier escalation team and requested an expedited ID card. If portal access is blocked, you can use this fallback link to generate a temp card: https://member.unitedcare.com/print-id (login required). I'll also submit a retroactive enrollment confirmation so the claim can be reprocessed.
Payroll Ops: Confirming from HRIS — spouse was added on 2024-04-01 and deductions are active. If UnitedCare requests an enrollment form or EOI, we can re-send immediately.
Aisha Khan: Provider wants pre-auth before tomorrow. Any tips for a quick workaround?
Kelsey (People Ops): Tell the provider to bill as 'out-of-network reimbursement' if they can, and note member is actively enrolled per our HRIS. I've asked UnitedCare to fast-track prior auth and to note the urgent appointment. Also requested they flag claim UC-489203 for re-review.
benefits-bot: Update from UnitedCare: Claim UC-489203 moved to 'pending review' and member record updated to include dependent on 1713571400.
Kelsey (People Ops): Carrier updated records and moved the claim to pending — I also requested an expedited payment. If you need a printed card now and that link fails, reply and I will call the provider line and confirm alternative IDs they will accept in person.
Aisha Khan: Carrier just notified me the claim was paid. Huge thanks — really appreciate the fast help :tada:
Kelsey (People Ops): Great news! If anything else pops up (ID cards, future denied claims), DM me and we should be able to resolve quickly. Also filing a short postmortem with UnitedCare on why dependent sync failed.
Jordan Lee: Filing the PM makes sense — thanks for handling the escalation.
Aisha Khan: Thanks everyone :heart:
